reason: Refactors ElasticsearchSearchContext's public API from a Query to a full SearchRequest (breaking signature change for any external code using this internal-but-public class) and changes custom-query error handling/validation behavior, which could alter search results or fail differently for existing Elasticsearch index profiles using custom queries.
